title: Drawing figures on the Cartesian plane

sections.title: Drawing figures on the Cartesian plane

subtopics.title: Drawing figures from coordinates
subtopics.exposition: The order of the letters in a figure's name indicates the order in which its vertices must be joined, with the last vertex joined back to the first. If the coordinates of a figure's vertices are given, the figure can be drawn on the Cartesian plane.

subtopics.title: Determining point coordinates
subtopics.exposition: A point's coordinates are written as the point's label followed by the coordinate pair in parentheses, separated by a semicolon, e.g. A(1, 1).

subtopics.title: Naming figures alphabetically
subtopics.exposition: It is conventional to name a figure by writing its vertices' letters in alphabetical order (e.g. ABCD, rather than CBAD or BADC).
